subject: HIPAA surcharge and trial billing allocation proposal
messages:
From: Daria Novak <daria@medpath.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alan Reyes <alan.reyes@medpath.com>, procurement@medpath.com
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: HIPAA surcharge and trial billing questions

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — the latency and cost numbers look promising. Before we move the pilot to procurement, the finance team flagged the HIPAA/residency surcharge and the HSM seat fee. Two quick questions:

1) For a 3-month pilot, do you typically charge the full residency + HSM seat up front, or can those be amortized across a longer PO?
2) Is there any way to offset the pilot surcharge via a trial credit or rebate once we move to a committed annual contract?

Procurement also asked for a simple itemized quote showing: base API usage estimate, residency (US-EAST) monthly surcharge, HSM seats (monthly), and any one-time implementation fees.

I've attached our PO template for reference (procurement cc'd).

Thanks —
Daria Novak
Head of Platform Ops
MedPath Health
[Attachment: medpath_po_template.pdf (pdf)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daria Novak <daria@medpath.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Alan Reyes <alan.reyes@medpath.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HIPAA surcharge and trial billing questions

Hi Daria — great to hear you liked the demo. Short answers up front: we can support amortization and we can offer a limited pilot credit that phases into an annual commit. Details below.

Attached: "hipaa_surcharge_options_v1.xlsx" — quick comparison table and two packaging pathways. High level:
- Option A: One-time implementation + full up-front residency commitment. Best for customers who want to avoid per-month surcharges; the one-time fee covers data residency validation and HSM bench provisioning.
- Option B: Monthly surcharge + per-seat HSM billing. No upfront capex, but higher OPEX during pilot.
- Option C (recommended for pilots): Amortize residency + initial HSM seat cost across a 12-month billed PO; we apply a pilot credit that covers months 1–3 of the residency surcharge if you convert to an annual commit within 60 days after pilot.

Pilot credit details (Option C):
- Credit: equal to residency surcharge for up to 3 months (applied as invoice credit).
- Eligibility: pilot usage within 90 days, conversion to 12-month commit with min throughput committed (we can set this in the SOW).
- If you don't convert, the pilot credit is waived and we bill the amortized amount per the PO.

Next steps I propose:
1) We send a formal quote (I'll loop in Marissa to produce the PDF).
2) Align on the min throughput anchor for the amortization (Ben can help with the math).
3) Proc signs PO and we start the pilot; credit applied once contract is countersigned.

Attaching the options spreadsheet for transparency. Thoughts?

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: hipaa_surcharge_options_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Mar 2027 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: RE: HIPAA surcharge and trial billing questions (internal)

Evelyn — quick internal note before we finalize the quote. A couple of pragmatic points:

- For the amortization math on Option C I recommend anchoring to a conservative estimated monthly token volume (we don't want to over-credit). I'll put together two scenarios (pilot low / pilot high) and a recommended floor.
- We can offer a capped pilot reimbursement instead of an open-ended 3-month refund: e.g., residency surcharge up to $6k total across the 3 months. That keeps credit exposure bounded for finance.
- If MedPath needs HSM for only a narrow pilot surface (not full tenant), suggest we quote a reduced "pilot HSM" seat at 50% of standard for months 1–3.

I'll draft the numbers and markups; Marissa can convert to the formal quote PDF.

—Ben
VP, Enterprise Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Daria Novak <daria@medpath.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alan Reyes <alan.reyes@medpath.com>, procurement@medpath.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HIPAA surcharge and trial billing questions

Evelyn — thanks, that helps a lot. Procurement reviewed your amortization approach and the capped pilot reimbursement makes sense to them. We're comfortable with Option C provided the cap is documented and the amortization schedule is visible on the quote. Two asks before we sign:

1) Could you send the formal quote with an amortization line item (monthly charge with total amortized amount) and the capped pilot credit explicitly shown as a deduction?
2) We need the PO-ready PDF (using our attached template) and a DocuSign link for the SOW + order form.

If you can get that to procurement this week, we can route internally and aim to start the pilot the week of Mar 22.

Attaching our PO template again.

Thanks —
Daria
Head of Platform Ops
MedPath Health
[Attachment: medpath_po_template.pdf (pdf)]
